title: Sabrina E Probable NDE 5298
content: I had a bleed on the brain, died and went to Heaven. There, I saw a lot of lights. The souls of those gone before me were the lights. It was like a room carpeted all over with lights. Way up front, there was God! My daughter stood behind God. She had passed about three years before. I made my way through the lights, and when I got up to the front, the Lord spoke to me. He said, 'I just wanted you to see that I have her and that she is fine.' I started trying to get to her but she wouldn't come to me! I used to spend days at her gravesite. My car would just never pass up the graveyard. On my way home from work, I would sit there and cry, make sure the site was clean. Anyway, God sent me BACK! He told me that she was his child not mine; that she was mine for only a moment. My grandma was the angel who brought me back. She kept saying, 'Go back baby, you will be fine.' Then my husband heard me talking aloud in the back of the house. He thought I was on the phone. When he looked, the phone was next to him. He came to see what I was doing. I was crying in my sleep and he woke me up. He says that I was acting really strange. So he dialed 911. When they got to the house, they asked me some questions, and I answered them, so they said that I was okay. My husband insisted that they take me. When I got to the hospital, it was found out that I was having bleeding on the brain. I was put in a helicopter and sent to another hospital to have brain surgery. The result of my brain surgery is that I have short-term memory problems. I can't tell you if I ate or if I did anything. It hurts, because I used to be such a tuff Lady! BUT to have seen what I have seen - it was all worth it.

arrival.other_being_detail: The experiencer reports seeing God, and also describes her grandma as an angel who brought her back.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as "like a room carpeted all over with lights"; the lights were said to be souls of those who had gone before her; "Way up front, there was God."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: God told her He wanted her to see that He has her deceased daughter and that she is fine; also said the daughter was His child and the experiencer had her only for a moment.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bleeding on the brain; later required helicopter transfer and brain surgery.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: The narrative begins with being in Heaven seeing many lights/souls and God, communication with God, then being sent back with the grandma/angel guiding the return; no tunnel or OBE described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Describes souls as lights carpeting a room; daughter standing behind God; grandma as the angel who brought her back; husband heard her talking aloud while she was asleep.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I just wanted you to see that I have her and that she is fine." "Go back baby, you will be fine." "He told me that she was his child not mine; that she was mine for only a moment."
